title: Step request (POST /gb/step body; one WS /gb/ws text frame)

t.description: game sim-step counter; must be last_t or last_t+1 (any value after reset)

value.description: power: kW(el), SIGNED net load (negative = zone exports, e.g. rooftop-PV backfeed — v1.md §4 power note) · heat: kW(th) >= 0 · water: m3/h >= 0 (backends may clamp heat/water). Missing zone => sample-and-hold.

additionalProperties.description: kind-specific, see v1.md §3.1 table (e.g. {p_kw} or {q_kw}); clamped to bounds with a 'clamped' violation
routed onto coupling_load devices; positive = draws from this network
